The image depicts a book open to a page featuring a collection of crocheted vegetables on a wooden cutting board.

The page showcases a variety of crocheted vegetables arranged on a wooden cutting board. From left to right, the vegetables include a green and white leek, a yellow lemon, a green and white cauliflower, an onion, a green cabbage, and three orange carrots with green tops.
